component.name: CLegendary Launcher
component.summary: Modern, fast and modular Minecraft launcher with multi-account and modpack management

description.p: CLegendary Launcher is a modern, cross-platform Minecraft launcher crafted with Avalonia UI. It provides seamless management of vanilla and modded Minecraft instances, custom skins, modpacks, server monitoring, and automated backups.

ul.li: Full support for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Quilt loaders
Integrated Modpack manager supporting CurseForge and local archives
Multi-account system: Microsoft OAuth login, LittleSkin custom auth, and offline profiles
Automated world backup system with instant restore capabilities
Built-in crash analysis and diagnosis powered by AI assistant
Fluid, responsive interface optimized for desktop and handheld gaming devices like Steam Deck

description.p: Preview 9.6: Improved modpack export cancellation, P2P discovery timeout, UI thread safety, enhanced localization, and official Flatpak packaging.
